description:
Use this when the user wants an everyday change to clips they have: "make the captions bigger and yellow",
"cut the silences and the ums", "bleep the swears". Set only what was asked; also_clip_ids does the same to
more clips in one call. Undo with undo_edit.
Not for: fonts, templates, filters, effects, speed or shape (style_clip), or overlays (add_to_clip). Costs no
Horizon Units. Returns job_id for job_status.

also_clip_ids.description: More clip ids to get the same change, up to 20 ("do it to all of them")

bleep.description: Swear words: beep (a tone, caption f***), mute, or off; empty = keep

caption_animation.description: bounce, pop, fade, none...; empty = keep

caption_color.description: Color name or hex like #FFD400; empty = keep

caption_position.description: auto, top, middle or bottom; empty = keep

caption_size.description: small, medium, large, x-large or 10-100; empty = keep

clip_id.description: Clip id from list_clips or a finished job

emojis.description: true = emojis in captions; omit = keep

highlight_color.description: Active-word color, name or hex; empty = keep

hook_title.description: Text at the top of the clip, or off; empty = keep

music.description: featured, phonk, hiphop, vlog, funny, chill, epic, upbeat, electronic, calm, acoustic, gaming, sad or off; empty = keep

remove_silences.description: Cut pauses of min_pause_seconds or more

trim_end_seconds.description: Seconds to cut from the end

trim_start_seconds.description: Seconds to cut from the start

uppercase.description: true = ALL CAPS captions; omit = keep

name: edit_clip
title: Edit a clip
